title: Can't Even Get the Pillow Into the Pillowcase!
text:
Can't Even Get the Pillow Into the Pillowcase!. I like pillowcases a bit larger than the pillow itself to ensure a good fit and in case the fabric shrinks in the dryer. I ordered these pillowcases in king size to fit 2 firm queen pillows. While the pillowcases measure
20" x 36", the hidden zipper on the side is only 13" long. The queen pillows (20" x 30") do not fit in the pillowcase. And by 'do not fit', I mean we couldn't get the pillow into the case even a few inches. We tried everything with no luck. In order to test one, I wound up having to cut the entire end of the pillowcase off (zipper side) to get the pillow in.

One side is the cooling side and it stays fairly cool at all times. Its soft and comfortable. The other side is bamboo cotton terry. Its soft but I didn't sleep on it.

The cases had a bit of an odd scent when removed from packaging but it did fade quickly.

I removed the pillowcase from the pillow and have no plans to use it or the other one. While they do stay pretty cool, one has the end cut off and the other won't fit on the pillow. If you plan on purchasing a king size set, I highly recommend measuring your pillow first. If its on the firm side like mine, you may face difficulty getting it through the 13" zippered opening.
